note: Committed surface must carry no personal identifiers. This file holds ONLY detection policy: provider domains, generic path segments, salted-free SHA-256 digests of denied terms, and reasoned allow entries. It deliberately contains no personal data in plaintext, so publishing it leaks nothing. Add a denied term with: node scripts/pii-scan.mjs --hash  (reads the term from stdin so it never lands in argv or shell history).

allow.reason: Invented identifiers that exist only to prove each rule fires; an unexercised detection rule cannot be trusted, and isolating the samples here keeps every other file fully scanned.
